name: Hotel Waldhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Waldhof is located in the district of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser and is surrounded by the imposing mountain backdrop of the Kaisergebirge. The architectural style of the house follows the traditional Tiroler country house, while the interiors are contemporary and functionally furnished. The guest rooms have balconies that offer a direct view of the rock faces of the Wilder Kaiser. Meals are provided as part of a classic half-board arrangement with breakfast buffet and evening menu. For relaxation, a wellness area with indoor pool, several saunas and a relaxation room is available. Hiking trails start directly at the hotel and lead across alpine meadows or to more challenging peaks in the surrounding area. The valley station of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser can be reached by ski bus in just a few minutes, and cross-country ski trails are right outside the door. The hotel is suitable for couples and families who want to combine a quiet holiday with sporting activities.
